{{Quote|I had thought no one would be&hellip;foolish enough to come down here. This is ours.|Bleth Fahr, to the Jedi-allied agents who came to recover the stolen Mandalorian iron box|<ref name="CD" />}}
'''Bleth Fahr''' was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Omwati/Legends|Omwati]] who lived during the last [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Fahr served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] but later abandoned the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and joined the [[Believers]], a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]-worshipping [[Sith cult|cult]] that operated in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]]. Around [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], Fahr was present at a secret [[Coruscant Believers base|Believer base]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and became involved in a Believer plot to acquire the [[Pulas]], an ancient [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifact]]. Fahr attempted to open a stolen [[Beskar/Legends|Mandalorian iron]] box that the Believers incorrectly thought contained the Pulas, but he was attacked and defeated by a group of [[Heroes of Cularin|Jedi-allied agents]] who had been sent to recover the stolen box.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Leave now, and take your lives. Remain, and we will take them.|Bleth Fahr, to the Jedi-allied agents who came to recover the stolen Mandalorian iron box|<ref name="CD" />}}
Bleth Fahr was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Omwati/Legends|Omwati]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the last [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Within the Order, he became a [[Jedi Guardian/Legends|Jedi Guardian]],<ref name="CD" /> a combat-orientated [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] specialization.<ref name="Core Rulebook">''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Core Rulebook]]''</ref> However, at some stage he fell to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] and became a [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]]. He abandoned the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Order and joined the Believers,<ref name="CD" /> a Sith-worshipping [[Sith cult|cult]]<ref name="BOTB">{{LivingForce|Metatheran Caution: Belly of the Beaast}}</ref> that was active in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]]. He also acquired a stolen [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] weapon which had been built by the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]].<ref name="CD" />

Around [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]],<ref name="Date">The ''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]'' states that the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'']] campaign is set one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] after the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], an event that is placed in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. Therefore, the events of ''[[Coruscani Dawn]]'' can be dated to circa [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]].</ref> a team of Jedi researchers discovered the Pulas, an ancient and powerful [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifact]] in the [[Almas Sith fortress|Sith fortress]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Almas]]. To prevent the Pulas from falling into the hands of the Believers, the Jedi [[Starship/Legends|shipped]] the artifact away from Almas, for safekeeping at the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]],<ref name="CD" /> the headquarters of the Jedi Order,<ref name="Databank">{{DB|location|jeditemple|Jedi Temple}}</ref> on the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The Believers schemed to steal the Pulas when it arrived on Coruscant and as part of the plot, Fahr, the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Scoundrel/Legends|scoundrel]] [[Malyas]] and a band of Believer thugs gathered at a [[Coruscant Believers base|secret base]] deep in the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Coruscant undercity]].<ref name="CD" />

With the assistance of [[Es'Loma]], a [[Tarasin]] [[The Force/Legends|Force]] [[Witch/Legends|witch]], a group of Believers seized a [[Beskar/Legends|Mandalorian iron]] box containing what they believed to be the Pulas from a Coruscant [[Hangar/Legends|landing platform]]. In truth the box was a decoy set by the Jedi to deceive the Believers and it instead contained a fragment of the dark-side imbued [[City/Legends|city]] [[Conkesta]]. The Believers transported the box to their secret undercity base; it was placed on an altar and Fahr attempted to open it using his lightsaber and a set of tools.<ref name="CD" />

{{RPG|''[[Coruscani Dawn]]''}}
A short [[Time/Legends|time]] later, a group of Jedi-allied [[Heroes of Cularin|agents]] arrived at the Believer facility in pursuit of the stolen box. Fahr threatened that the Believer [[Sith cultist/Legends|cultists]] would [[Death/Legends|kill]] the agents if the operatives did not leave the base immediately. The agents did not retreat and in the ensuing fight, Fahr, Es'Loma, Malyas and the Believers thugs were defeated. The [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Iron/Legends|iron]] box was subsequently recovered by the agents and escorted to the Jedi Temple.<ref name="CD" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Death to the Unbelievers!|Bleth Fahr, to the Jedi-allied agents who came to recover the stolen Mandalorian iron box|<ref name="CD" />}}
Bleth Fahr was [[Color/Legends|blue]]-skinned with white [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and thin features. Though outspoken in his support of the Believers, Fahr was not fully corrupted by their ideology. He sought to recruit others to join the cult and to that end he drew upon his experience as a former Jedi by showing mercy to his targets in order to gain an advantage in his efforts to manipulate them. When in a difficult situation, Fahr would refuse to surrender even if at cost of his life. To that end, during the raid on the Believer Coruscant undercity base by the Jedi-allied agents Fahr's sole aim was to escape with the stolen Mandalorian iron box at whatever cost.<ref name="CD" />

==Powers and abilities==
Fahr was proficient in the use of the Force to [[Force sense|sense things]], [[Telekinesis/Legends|grip and push]] objects, to [[Tutaminis|drain energy]] and to [[Force healing/Legends|heal]] and [[Enhance Attribute|strengthen]] himself. He was also familiar with the [[Force power/Legends|powers]] [[Battlemind]], [[Hatred]], [[Sense Force|See Force]] and [[Force storm (weather)|Summon Storm]]. In addition, Fahr was capable in the art of [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]].<ref name="CD" />

==Equipment==
While in service to the Believers, Fahr wore black [[Clothing/Legends|robes]] and he wielded a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] and a [[Mace Windu's practice lightsaber|purple-bladed lightsaber]] that was built by Jedi Master Mace Windu for [[Jedi training/Legends|training]] purposes but was lost in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region while on loan to a Jedi [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] and changed [[Limb/Legends|hands]] several times before it was acquired by Fahr.<ref name="CD" />

==Behind the scenes==
Bleth Fahr was created by [[Morrie Mullins]] and appeared in ''[[Coruscani Dawn]]'', a [[2002]] [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game|roleplaying]] adventure that formed part of Year 2 of the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|Living Force]] campaign. The adventure debuted at [[Celebration II]],<ref name="CD" /> a ''[[Star Wars]]'' fan convention held in [[Wikipedia:Indianapolis|Indianapolis]], [[Wikipedia:Indiana|Indiana]].<ref name="Celebration II">{{SWArchive|url=community/event/celebration/f20020507|text=starwars.com @ Celebration II}}</ref>

In ''Coruscani Dawn'', the players [[Roleplaying game|role-play]] as the agents sent to retrieve the stolen Mandalorian iron box and various different outcomes are possible following the their encounter with Fahr at the Believer hideout. If the player characters apprehend a Believer guard posted to watch the entrance to their base, their arrival takes Fahr and the other cultist by surprise. Alternatively, the guard can forewarn Fahr of the coming of the Jedi-allied agents, in which case Fahr and the other cultists gather in the central chamber of the base to await the player characters' arrival. It is possible for the players to incapacitate or kill Fahr and for them to take his lightsaber from him.<ref name="CD" />

In ''Coruscani Dawn'' it is also possible for the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Devan For'deschel]] to join the player characters in their fight against Fahr. If For'deschel [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|duels]] with Fahr and comes close to overcoming him, Fahr gets a lucky strike against her at the last moment and then flees. If the player characters are defeated and immobilized by the Believers, Fahr ensures that they receive medical treatment to steady their condition and leaves some [[Medpac/Legends|medpacs]] next to them. He then escapes with the other Believers into the Coruscant undercity.<ref name="CD" />
